messages:
Alex: flagging a public partner PR that contains a service account JSON (looks long-lived). dropping here for triage.
Priya: paste redacted snippet?
Alex: `{... "private_key_id":"b4f...", "private_key":"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----...-----END PRIVATE KEY-----" ...}`
Jun: which repo/PR?
Alex: partner/inbound#372, forked from contrib42. they say it was a test payload.
Sam: immediate steps: mark compromised, revoke key, rotate consumers, notify partner/legal.
oncall-bot: incident-sev:high. add checklist: evidence, rotation, RBAC audit.
Nico: running `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list` for ingest-sa... found matching key id. deleting now.
Priya: good. Jun, scan logs/archives for copies (GCS, logs export). Sam, patch CI to stop writing keys to disk and add secret-scan.
Jun: found one object in partner-dev-uploads/tmp/PR-372/sa.json (2025-11-02). initiating deletion and retention override request.
Sam: opened PR to add pre-commit secret-scan and remove any job that writes SA keys to /tmp. asking partner to merge.
Nico: created new key id c9e7..., attaching same minimum roles. will tighten roles after audit.
Priya: check Vault/KMS interaction: was this SA ever wrapped or imported? Jun: searching Vault audits for `ingest-sa` and private_key - none found.
Alex: partner says PR and fork removed at 2026-03-21T15:12Z. legal wants timeline + proof.
Priya: owners: Nico (rotate/create keys + IAM audit), Sam (CI fix + alert tuning), Jun (archive purge + evidence), Alex (partner comms + legal).
Sam: adding alert: pages on SA key create/delete for prod SAs. will deploy in 30m.
Jun: drafting post-incident runbook updates and commands (`gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete`, grep patterns, evidence upload paths).
oncall-bot: incident-sev:monitor.
Alex: ok marking contained for now. will reopen if more artifacts appear. :thumbsup:
